description: Generate an A/B test report comparing two prompts or model configurations. Accepts arrays of scores and returns mean, median, std deviation, improvement percentage, and a Welch t-test at 95 %: `winner` names a variant only when the difference is significant — otherwise "no_significant_difference", or "insufficient_samples" under 2 scores per variant.

variant_a.description: First variant configuration with name and score array

variant_b.description: Second variant configuration with name and score array

name: ab_test_report
